steps.title: Read the trace

steps.text: The agent repeated the code's warning as its verdict. The instruction said what the inputs mean, but never that a warning is a reason to look at the numbers, not a reason to reject. So 'when unsure, send to a drafter' won every time.
steps.title: Find the cause

steps.text: 2 rooms became regression cases with the verdict a drafter would expect, including h07-r1 (accept) and a bathroom with a truly missing door (send to drafter). tests/test_failure_fix.py fails if a rerun breaks any of them.
steps.title: Add the case

steps.text: Each warning now says what to check: a weak spot or an overlap is fine when this room's measurements match the tour; a label mismatch alone does not change quantities; a door-count mismatch still goes to a drafter, because a missing door is a real error type.
steps.title: Change the instruction

steps.text: False alarms 71 to 36 of 250 clean rooms; errors caught 32 to 32 of 32; rooms sent to a drafter 103 to 68 (35 fewer). h07-r1 now: accept, "The plan agrees with the tour within normal measurement noise: the ceiling is 0.1 ft off, and the walls are off by 0.1 ft or 2 %."
